title: BenchX environment identity
description: The shape of coordinates.environment when coordinates.environment.schema is "benchx/env-identity/0.1.0" (docs/design/runner-schema.md §5.2). A fact goes in identity when a change should split history, and in metadata otherwise.
$comment: coordinates.environment.identity is deliberately open in schemas/measurement-result/0.1.0 (minProperties: 1 only), to allow other identity schemas. A validator applies this schema to a result's coordinates.environment object only when its schema field equals "benchx/env-identity/0.1.0". GPU UUIDs stay out of identity (in metadata) so that swapping a card of the same model does not split history; the device a result used is coordinates.resource_selection, not here.

gpus.description: Visible accelerators by model. GPU UUIDs are metadata, not here.

policy.description: The environment policy applied, as name@version (schemas/environment-policy/0.1.0).

enforced.description: The values the policy actually applied, keyed by check name (runner-schema.md §4.1).

metadata.description: Descriptive facts that do not enter environment identity: hostname, GPU UUIDs, BIOS/firmware strings.
